notes: The potentiometer in the image straddles the breadboard centre gap: its outer legs are in columns 10 and 12 of the a-e half, and its centre (wiper) leg is in column 11 of the f-j half. I used bank 't' for rows a-e and 'b' for rows f-j, as the catalogue defines them.
The pot's outer legs are symmetric (GND=VCC). I put the leg in column 10 on GND and the leg in column 12 on VCC, matching the black and red wires.
The black wire goes to the second GND pin in the Arduino power header, which I mapped to GND.2.
The USB cable is not drawn in the circuit image, but the part list includes it. It connects the Arduino to the computer for serial output, and I added a joined edge to the Uno with no port.
The wire colours come from the image: red is 5V, black is GND, and yellow is the A0 signal.
